name: Ling 3.2 Air official FP8 (124B, 5.5B active) runs across two DGX Sparks with vLLM TP=2 at 47 tok/s single stream
title: Ling 3.2 Air official FP8 (124B, 5.5B active) runs across two DGX Sparks with vLLM TP=2 at 47 tok/s single stream
summary: A builder split the 129 GB FP8 checkpoint over two linked Sparks with tensor parallelism and measured 47.11 tok/s with thinking on, after vLLM rejected the first two launch attempts. A data point for anyone sizing a two-Spark setup.
